S9:18.text: and take thence your father and kinne, and come to me and I wil geue you al the good things of Ægypt, that you may eate the marow of the land.

S9:19.text: commandment alſo that they take waynes out of the land of Ægypt, for the carage of their litle ones and wyues: and ſay Take vp your father, and make haſt to come with al ſpede.

S9:2.text: And he lifted vp his voice with weeping, which the Ægyptians heard, and al the houſe of Pharao.

S9:3.text: And he ſaid to his Brethren: I am Ioſeph : is my father yet liuing His brethren, could not anſwer him being teribly aſtonyed out of meaſure.

S9:5.text: Be not affraid, neither let it ſeeme to you a hard caſe that you did ſel me into theſe countries for :: God ſent me before you into Ægypt for your preſeruation.

S9:6.text: For it is two yeares ſince the famin begain to be vpon the earth, and yet fiue yeares remaine, wherin there can be neither earing nor reaping.
